blocks.content: Exam traps are designed to test alertness and precision rather than mere memory.

items: Negative wording in question stems is the single most common cause of avoidable mark loss.
Always verify all four options completely before marking your response.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Always read question stems carefully for keywords like 'NOT', 'INCORRECT', or 'EXCEPT'.
Pay strict attention to unit conversions before performing mathematical calculations.
Distinguish between absolute statements and conditional statements in logical reasoning.
Beware of option traps where Option A seems correct but Option D is 'All of the above'.
